m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: You say you want to find a Frost Colossus? Are you mad? Have you taken leave of your senses?
Oh, you need to find one for your quest spell. Why didn't you say that first! Mmmm... I don't know any offhand, but I know someone who would.
Talk to the Balance Tree. He's wise and knows all of Krokotopia. I haven't seen him since the worlds broke apart, so say "Hi" to him for me.
You say you know Kelvin? Sure, I still remember him, even if it has been eons since I last laid eyes on him. So, you are looking for a Frost Colossus...
Has the sun driven you mad!?! Oh, you need to find one for your spell quest. Just go into the Krokosphinx and try the door next to Rami in the Hall of Champions.
Please come back to me after you have retrieved the Medallion. I would fear the Colossus got the better of you.
Glad to see you made it back! Let me see what you have retrieved. Mmmmm... Looks like the Medallion suffered some damage during combat.
If you take and dip it into the icy waters just inside the Krokosphinx I'm sure that will mend it. Off you go now...
Good show, bringing that Medallion back in one piece! I mean... Good show YOU returning in one piece. Some students don't. But I knew you would.
Ah, the Medallion is flawless. This will make for a powerful spell. You have but one last task...
Do you have the Ice Medallion I sent you to get?
So, you feel up to another quest spell. Though you will have to travel far to the reaches of Krokotopia, you will find Ice Armor well worth it.
Find a Frost Colossus. His Ice Medallion will be used to create your spell. To find one I suggest talking with Kelvin...
